notes.title: Demo update 11/1/2022
notes.content:
The new version includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] The cursor will now be locked during the game, and confined to the screen space during game menus.

[*] Cursor will no longer stay under the pause menu.

[*] Fixed camera transition when the bad guy appears.

[*] Interaction indicators adjusted

[*] Fixed bug in the map, which caused Carla to stand on the woodshed at a certain point.

[*] Fixed vibration in Carla's animation when she was crouching down

[*] Fixed problem with the rain during the death cinematic

[*] Adjusted Canuto's position so that he is not floating

[*] Reduced the amount of red vignette when Carla is in danger
[/list]

Thank you very much for playing our demo and for reporting us the problems so we can improve the game.

[b]You are awesome[/b]
